feeds.title: DB's Medical Rants
feeds.description: db is the nickname for Dr. Robert M. Centor. I am an academic general internist at the University of Alabama School of Medicine. Recently I retired (or semi-retired) and became Professor-Emeritus. I still make rounds at the Birmingham VA (3.5 months per year) and go to the Huntsville campus to round with students and residents 10 weeks each year). This blog represents my thoughts and in no way represents any of my employers.
